Historically, authoritarian regimes have faced inherent constraints that eventually checked their power: Economic growth requires skilled workers who may demand political rights, and effective militaries risk becoming independent power centers. Advanced AI could loosen both. Automated systems could reduce dependence on workers who might organize for reform, while AI-enabled surveillance lowers the cost of monitoring and suppressing dissent.
